name: World War II Service Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 176 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.6875 x 0.707 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.6875 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 284.6 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle -2.6 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-cap-world-war-2-service-ribbon-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

generator: artwork-samples/assets/medals-work/design/wwii.js (parameters in inches) over lib.js, common.js, font.js, emit.js; gates: kitA.js; node makeA.js wwii --write
source_raster: vanguardmil.com product civil-air-patrol-wartime-wwii-service-miniature-medal (civil air patrol wartime wwii service miniature medal), 600 x 600 px, measurement reference only

source_product.title: civil air patrol wartime wwii service miniature medal
source_product.note: measurement reference only: never shipped, never committed

measured.photo: wartime-wwii-service.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: The photograph's engraving grain, wear and specular highlights are not drawn (flat tones).

The suspension ring is hidden by the ribbon above its lower third: its centre and radius are fitted to the visible lower arcs (0.134 in outer radius), the upper part is assumed circular; the full body shows it complete.
The rim is a plain flat band: the photograph shows no separate ridge, so the rim annulus (0.2985 to 0.3095 in) is the lit band itself.

The engraved star outline and the rays are thin lines near the resolution of the photograph (one pixel = 0.0035 in): their widths (0.004 and 0.0075 in) are set from the blurred line profile; the star valleys on the diagonals lie under the hub circle and are placed (0.104 in) from the straight edges that run into them.
Letter stroke 0.0078 in is judged from the zoom comparison, thinner than the threshold-blurred 0.0095 in.

palette.ramp: ramp measured from the reference metal (ramp.js)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from wartime-wwii-service.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Reference check: the disc shows CIVIL AIR PATROL / WARTIME SERVICE round an eight-point star with a three-blade propeller in a hub circle: the CAP Wartime (World War II) Service medal. Hang angle -2.6 deg of the photograph removed: the body hangs upright.
